title: Understanding the Model
text: The model is given by f_theta(x)=theta_0+theta_1*veg+theta_2*(meat=beef)+theta_3*(meat=fish). Identify the values of theta from the fitted model.

title: Identify the Variables
text: For the second data point, $$veg=3$$ and $$meat=fish$$. Substitute these values into the model equation.

title: Calculate the Predicted Total
text: Substitute the values into the model: f_theta(x)=-3+5*3+8*(meat=beef)+12*(meat=fish). Since $$meat=fish$$, set $$(meat=fish)=1$$ and $$(meat=beef)=0$$.

title: Compute the Squared Error Loss
text: The squared error loss is given by (predicted_total - actual_total)**2. Use the predicted total from the model and the actual total from the dataset.

title: Calculate the Predicted Total
text: Calculate the predicted total using the model: $$\operatorname{f_{\theta}}\left(x\right)=-3+5\times3+8\times0+12\times1$$.
